user.title: Set up AirOS Device
user.description: Set up your AirOS device. This integration communicates with your device over an SSH connection. Enter your device's host address and login credentials to get started.

data_description.host: Set up your AirOS device. This integration communicates with your device over an SSH connection. Enter your device's host address and login credentials to get started.
data_description.username: The username used to log in to your AirOS device over SSH.
data_description.password: The password used to log in to your AirOS device over SSH.
